title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:BUNK SLEEPER:TRUCK (122 affected)
summary: STRAPS HOLDING THE SLEEPER UPPER BUNK IN THE RAISED POSITION CAN RELEASE WITHOUT WARNING.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:MARKINGS (6,603 affected)
summary: THE MAXIMUM INFLATION PRESSURE STAMPING ON THE OPPOSITE SERIAL SIDE OF THE TIRES IS INCORRECT FOR BOTH SINGLE AND DUAL LOADS. A PRESSURE OF 30 PSI IS STAMPED FOR BOTH SINGLE AND DUAL LOAD APPLICATIONS. THE CORRECT STAMPING ON THE TIRE SHOULD READ A MAXIMUM OF 50 PSI.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY (1,090 affected)
summary: IF A PASSENGER TRIES TO EXIT THE LAVATORY COMPARTMENT BY PUSHING WITH HIS BACK AGAINST THE LAVATORY WINDOW AND HIS LEGS AGAINST THE LAVATORY DOOR, THE WINDOW CAN SEPARATE.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL (2,075 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE BUTTON CAN BE HIT ACCIDENTLY ALLOWING THE PARKING BRAKE TO RELEASE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (3,076 affected)
summary: THE METAL HOUSING OF THE SAFETY BELT RETRACTORS ON AUTOMATIC LOCKING RETRACTOR/EMERGENCY LOCKING RETRACTOR SAFETY BELTS CAN BECOME DEFORMED PREVENTING EXTENSION AND/OR RETRACTION OF THE BELT.

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:DRUM (90 affected)
summary: THE MACHINING PERFORMED ON THE BRAKE DRUMS WILL NOT PERMIT THE DRUM TO SEAT FULLY AGAINST THE HUB FACE.  THE REDUCED BRAKE DRUM AND HUB CONTACT AREA WILL ABRADE AND FRET ALLOWING THE WHEEL MOUNTING JOINT TO LOOSEN.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (185,000 affected)
summary: THE CINCH BAR COMPONENT WITHIN THE PASSENGER SIDE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY SHATTERS CAUSING THE BELT TO RELEASE.

title: Hyundai Motor America: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HIGH/LOW BEAM DIMMER (1,638 affected)
summary: A PLASTIC SLIDER PIECE WITHIN THE HEADLAMP DIMMER SWITCH ASSEMBLY DOES NOT FULLY RETRACT WHEN THE HEADLAMP DIMMER SWITCH IS MOVED FROM LOW BEAM TO HIGH BEAM POSITION. THE LOW BEAM LAMPS GO OUT AS INTENDED, BUT THE HIGH BEAM LAMPS DO NOT COME ON.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (70 affected)
summary: WASHERS WERE NOT INSTALLED ON THE PASSENGER SIDE RETRACTOR AND OUTBOARD SAFETY BELT ANCHORS. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS," AND FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/BRAKE HOSES (68 affected)
summary: CERTAIN OF THE BRAKE HOSES FOR THE RIGHT REAR WHEEL WERE ROUTED INCORRECTLY SO THAT CONTACT IS MADE WITH A SUSPENSION COMPONENT.  THIS CAUSES ABRASION TO THE HOSE AND EVENTUAL LEAKAGE.

title: Ford Motor Company: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:DOOR AND SIDE (2,512 affected)
summary: THE GLASS TEMPERING PROCESS ON THE RIGHT HAND REAR DOOR WINDOWS WAS NOT CORRECTLY PERFORMED. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 205, "GLAZING MATERIALS."

title: HPA MONON TRAILER, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (304 affected)
summary: MISSING WELDS IN THE UPPER COUPLER ASSEMBLY CAN LEAD TO FATIGUE CRACKS IN THE BOTTOM PLATE OF THE ASSEMBLY OVER A LENGTH OF TIME, CAUSING FAILURE OF THE UPPER COUPLER ASSEMBLY.

title: EMERALD ISLE OF SO. CAL.: EQUIPMENT:VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER AND PLATE (3 affected)
summary: THE MANUFACTURER'S IDENTIFICATION LABEL WAS OMITTED. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 115, "VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER - BASIC REQUIREMENTS."

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (80 affected)
summary: A POWER CONNECTOR IN THE MAIN WIRING HARNESS CAN BECOME CORRODED CAUSING LOSS OF POWER.
